create_uc3d_dataset: create a UCO3DDataset instance with SQLite metadata file and subset lists for train/val/test splits
build_dataset_index: build a filtered dataset index from subset lists or the full database with sequence and frame filters
get_frame_data: get UCO3DFrameData by ordinal index or (sequence_name, frame_number) tuple with optional blob loading
iterate_sequence_frames: iterate sequence frames in order returning (timestamp, frame_number, dataset_index) triplets
load_sequence_annotations: load sequence annotations as a pandas DataFrame from the SQLite metadata database
